spans.s: Caṇḍabala, a monkey. § 539 (Kumbhakarṇādivadha): III, 287, 16414 (devoured by Kumbhakarṇa).
Caṇḍabhārgava, a brahman. § 59 (Sarpasattra): I, 53, 2045 (tatra--i.e. at the snake sacrifice of Janamejaya--hotā babhūvātha Caṇḍabhārgavaḥ | Cyavanasyānvaye khyāto vipro vedavidāṃ varaḥ).

Caṇḍakauśika, a muni, son of Kākshīvat. § 275 (Rājasūyār.): II, 17, 698 (Kākshīvataḥ putraṃ Gautamasya); 19, 741 (C. uttered mantras over a mango fruit, which the queens of Bṛhadratha ate up; then Jarāsandha was born).

*Caṇḍāla^1, name of a caste. § 721 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 3, 199 (ºyonau jātaḥ, sc. Mataṅga).--§ 735 (do.): XIII, 27, 1895 (ºyonau jātena, sc. Mataṅga); 29, 1916 (do.).--§ 743b (Vipulop.): XIII, 40, 2276 (ºsamadarśanaḥ, sc. Indra).-§ 744 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 48, 2589 (the son of a C. with a Vaidehī becomes a Saupāka; read Saupākaḥ with B.).-§ 749 (do.): XIII, 91, 4368 (ºśvapacau, should be excluded from a śrāddha).

*Cāṇḍāla^1 (mostly pl., = Caṇḍāla^1). § 562 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 92, 3291.--§ 641 (Rājadh.): XII, 76, 2874 (brāhmaṇacºāḥ).--§ 659 (Mokshadh.): XII, 180, 6727 (sg.).--§ 702 (do.): XII, 297, 10869; 298, 10931 (ºtve).--§ 705 (do.): XII, 303, 11245.--§ 744 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 47, 2535 (brāhmaṇacāṇḍālaḥ); 48, 2572 (sg., son of a śūdra with a brāhmaṇī), 2583 (the son of a C. with a Sairandhrī becomes a śvapāka), 2588 (the son of a C. [with a Nishādī?]
becomes a pāṇḍusaupāka), 2590; 49, 2613 (son of a śūdra with a brāhmaṇī).--§ 782g (Guruśishya saṃv.): XIV, 36, 1016.--§ 784b (Uttaṅka): XIV, 55, 1620 (ºrūpī, sc. Indra).

Cāṇḍāla^2, sg. (single Cāṇḍālas): (a) = Parigha: XII, 4935, 5008, 5028 (Parighaḥ), 5034, 5035, 5110. (b) (the C. who discoursed with Viśvāmitra): XII, 5330, 5353, 5355, 5361, 5362, 5363, 5366, 5373, 5376. (c) (the C. who conversed with a kshatrabandhu): XIII, 4814 foll.

Cāṇḍālikāśrama, a tīrtha. By repairing to C. and bathing in Kokāmukha, after having subsisted upon potherbs and having worn ragged clothes, one is sure to obtain ten maidens (differently Nīl.): XIII, 25, 1738 (only C.; B. Āñjalikāśramaṃ).
Caṇḍatuṇḍaka, a Suparṇa, son of Garuḍa. § 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 101, 3594.
Caṇūra^1, a prince. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 121 (among the princes who waited upon Yudhishṭhira, when he entered his palace).
Caṇūra^2. § 567 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 130, 4410 (had been slain by Kṛshṇa).
